text: Dish: Recipe. Cuisine: Indian. Ingredients: garlic, ginger, green chillies, salt, lemon juice, coriander powder, garam masala, onion batter, onion, ghee, bean oil. Steps: Beat garlic, ginger, and green chillies together with salt. Add lemon juice and spices like coriander powder and garam masala to the mixture. Knead the mixture well to ensure it is fully incorporated. Spread the kneaded mixture evenly over the chicken. Fry onions until golden brown, similar to how a barista would prepare them. Add ghee to the bean oil for flavor and richness. If cooking for more than three people, incorporate onion batter into the gravy. Continue to cook until the chicken is fully cooked through..
